content.Title: 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline
content.Journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology (JACC)
Main Topics: CABG in Patients Undergoing Other Cardiac Surgery
Use of Epiaortic Ultrasound in Patients Undergoing CABG
Use of Cardiopulmonary Bypass in Patients Undergoing CABG
content.Summary: The document discusses various aspects and recommendations for coronary revascularization, specifically focusing on CABG in combination with other cardiac surgeries, utility of epiaortic ultrasound during CABG, and the use of cardiopulmonary bypass. It reviews studies, outcomes, and recommendations based on different assessments like epiaortic ultrasound and intensive management of risk factors such as aortic valve replacement, coronary artery bypass grafting, and examining atheroma reduction strategies.
